description.value:
A 10-foot-radius sphere of power suppression envelops you and moves with you for the duration. Within it, powers cannot be cast, and enhanced items function as mundane equivalents; a slot spent attempting to cast inside the sphere is still consumed. Any power or enhanced effect suppressed by the sphere simply does not function while inside, though its duration continues to elapse.

Powers or effects targeting a creature or object in the sphere have no effect on it. An enhanced area of effect, such as an explosion, cannot extend into the sphere; any overlapping portion is suppressed. Any power or enhanced effect already active on something in the sphere stops functioning while it remains there. Enhanced items lose their bonuses and properties while inside the sphere, or while used against a target within it, or while wielded by an attacker within it; an enhanced weapon or piece of ammunition regains its properties the instant it fully exits the sphere. Teleportation and portals fail to function with the sphere as either origin or destination. A creature or object created or summoned by a power vanishes temporarily while inside the sphere, reappearing once its space is no longer within it. Effects such as *tech override* have no power over the sphere itself, and multiple *scrambling field* spheres do not cancel one another out.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 8
